answer: Make each epoch claim retire a unique, registry-listed 1 kg carbon-removal certificate: the contract verifies its issuer signature and serial, then marks that serial spent before activating the identity. This is a proposal, not a current protocol rule; budget /bin/bash.15 per certificate. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.15 once; 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 certificates and cost 50 (1,000 × /bin/bash.15). A velvet, juniper, cipher phrase can bind the receipt to the round. Limitation: weak offsets or deep pockets can undermine the deterrent.
